subject: Re: Thursday appointment
text: That appointment should still work, though I wanted to mention the entrance before you arrive on Thursday. The main desk will be closed for maintenance in the morning, so the side door by the old courier bay is the easiest way in. It isn't very well marked, and a few people have wandered past it looking for the front lobby, so if you don't see someone immediately, just take the ramp beside the bicycles and follow the blue signage. Parking is also a bit tight that week, and I'm not sure the visitors' spaces will be open. The short-term bay near the laundromat is the safest option, even if it means a few minutes' walk. Bring your photo ID if you have one, not because anyone will interrogate you, but because the temporary reception screen requests it. If anything changes, I'll send a quick note, but I didn't want you to turn up and start hunting around for the right doorway. Also, if the side door is locked, text me on the number you already have and I'll come collect you; I don't want you standing outside in the rain with all those files and coffee too. There should be a spare chair in the small meeting room, so really no need to rush. I'll be inside by ten, so don't worry if you're a little late.
